name: Shitei Furin ~Hitozuma Sado Ane to no Kinshin Kozukuri~
original_name: 姉弟不倫 ～人妻サド姉との近親子作り～
source: The protagonist has been secretly in love with his sister for many years and was last year she got married. His sister and her husband came to visit for 5 days but on first day husband had to leave. The protagonist plotted to try and steal her away from husband as this was his best chance. But would be in for a surprise when things take a turn he wasn't expecting.
translation: 主角暗恋妹妹多年，并于去年结婚。他的姐姐和她的丈夫来看望了五天，但第一天丈夫就不得不离开。主角密谋试图将她从丈夫身边偷走，因为这是他最好的机会。但当事情发生意想不到的转变时，他会感到惊讶。
